page.layout: One printed page, 377. A single column of text, with numbered and starred notes in a narrow column on the right. Signature and catchword at the foot.

main_text.p: ابو عبد الله محمد بن سلامة بن جعفر القضاعي Abu Abdollah Mohammed Ebn Salamah Ebn Jaafar AlKodaai quod patronymicum est ab القضاعة tribu-um patre. scripsisse videtur circa annum H.437.ad cu-jus finem ab initio mundi numerari à Græcis ait annos 6554. Obiit anno 454. Ebn Chal. & Jalaloddin:

AlDamirius ] كمال الدين ابو البقا محمد بن موسى بن عيسى الدميري Cemaloddin Abul Bakai Mohammed Ebn Musa, Ebn Isa AlDamiri, libri de historia animalium cui titulus حيوة الحيوان author. obiit anno H.808. Jalaloddin.

Thabet Ebn Corrab] qui vulgo Thebit audit ثابت بن قرة بن هرون الصابي الحراني Thabet Ebn Korrah Ebn{*}Harun Alsabi (seu religione Sabiista) Harrani, Medicus, Mathematicus & Philosophus insignis, magno ob insignem eruditionem, in honore apud Chalifam AlMootadedum, teste Gregorio nostro. natus est anno H. 221. mortuus 288. Ebn Chalec. Fuit etiam ei nepos nomine ثابت بن سنان Thabet Ebn Senan iisdem artibus clarus.

Phacrod'din Razi] magnus seculi sui antistes. Commentario in Alkoranum celebri, aliisque ingenii monimentis clarus. ابو الفضل محمد بن عمر الطبرستاني الاصل الرازي الدولن AbulFadl Mohammed Ebn Omar, AlTabarastani ortu, AlRazi, natu. Natus scil. in urbe رى Rai anno H. 543. vel juxta alios 544. obiit anno 606.
Logat Halimi] لغت حليمي Nomenclator Arabico Persicus.

page.notes: Marginal numbers 135, 138, 145 and 146 stand beside entries 2, 3, 4 and 5 and are printed in the right margin. The asterisk note in the right margin reads "Ebn Chal. at Greg:" with Arabic مروان. The Arabic in the entry about Abul Fadl ends in a word I read as الدولن; the last letters are uncertain. The reading "Alsabi" is inferred from the parenthesis "seu religione Sabiista", with long s set as f in the print. The Arabic title of the Damiri work and the Arabic of "Logat Halimi" are reproduced as best seen. No running head is printed. Catchword and signature are at the foot.
